narrative.overview:
Leonida is a cinematic night-city editorial house: photography and type carry the page; UI chrome recedes. One keyed dusk photograph, Bodoni italic against Bebas display, rectangular metallic glass, and a single hot-pink conversion color. It borrows GTA-VI–era night heat without Rockstar marks or affiliation. The first viewport is a full-bleed scene with a left type stack — Bodoni italic “Vice City” in hot pink over Bebas “Never plays / by the rules.” — then one rectangular primary CTA and a text secondary to the journal. No metric strip, no pill chip cluster, no centered SaaS logo stack, no gradient-filled display type.

Chrome is a floating rectangular metallic sheet (nav), not a pill. Nav links are tracked caps with a 1px hot underline, not glass chips. Merchandise cards are sharp charcoal slabs (border-radius 2px). Journal pages are magazine layouts: asymmetric mastheads, full-bleed covers, Bodoni feature titles, pull quotes. Atmosphere is film grain + vignette on cinematic black — not a full-bleed pink/blue aurora wallpaper.

Density is generous editorial: max-w-[1600px], gutters 20 / 32 / 48 / 64, section padding 80 / 112. Motion is exponential ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), plus scroll-driven clip/rise reveals, staggered cards, a 2px hot progress line, and hero parallax that fades on scroll.
keyCharacteristics: Cinematic black ground (#07060A) with midnight stage (#0E0C14)
Hot pink (#FF2D6F) as the only conversion color — CTAs, Bag, prices, active tags
Rectangular metallic glass on the floating nav; opaque 2px charcoal on product cards
Bebas Neue for LEONIDA / room shouts, Bodoni Moda for editorial, Manrope for UI
Keyed cinematic hero (character + car + highway) as the signature artifact
Film grain + vignette; cyan / burgundy / navy only as lighting, never as button fills
Magazine journal: feature split, Bodoni titles, pull quotes, object-cover photos
Scroll-driven clip/rise reveals, staggered grids, 2px hot progress line

rules.name: The Hot Rarity Rule
rules.body: #FF2D6F is conversion, not wallpaper. It belongs on the irreversible CTA, Bag, price, focus ring, progress line, and a hot tag. It does not fill heroes, cards, or nav bars.

rules.name: The Cinematic-Black Rule
rules.body: Ground and panels stay in the #07060A / #0E0C14 / #16131E family. Navy and burgundy may tint the body wash. Do not restyle the house onto #0A0A0C pill chrome or #0B0716 / #E85A9B from stale brand-spec notes.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bebas signs the house and the rooms. Bodoni Moda titles the editorial. Manrope does the work. Do not set body in Bebas, CTAs in serif, or revive Instrument Serif.

rules.name: The No-Gradient-Type Rule
rules.body: Display type is solid white, mist, or hot pink. Do not fill headlines with gradients.

rules.name: The Rectangle-Is-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Nav sheet, chips, CTAs, Bag, logo lockup, and product cards are border-radius 2px. Frosted glass belongs on the floating nav and the cart drawer. Do not restore pill chrome.

rules.name: The Photography-Leads Rule
rules.body: The hero still, journal covers, and Discover blur carry the page. Chrome recedes. Do not put a metric strip in the first viewport.

rules.name: The One-Pixel Lift Rule
rules.body: Hover on chips, Bag, logo, and cards is translateY(-1px) (photos also scale 1.03–1.04). Anything larger leaves the house, except authored scroll reveals.

dos: Do keep void / night / ink as the ground family and #FF2D6F as the only conversion color.
Do set room shouts in Bebas (.title-display) and editorial titles in Bodoni (font-serif / .title-italic).
Do use Manrope for UI — it is what --font-ui loads.
Do keep chrome at border-radius 2px. Glass on the nav sheet and bag drawer; charcoal slabs on product cards.
Do set journal as a magazine: feature split, Bodoni titles, pull quotes, object-cover photos.
Do keep the hero as one keyed scene with a left type stack, one rectangular CTA, and a text journal link.
Do keep the logo glow on an outer filter: drop-shadow wrap so it does not clip to a rectangle.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by dropping progress, reveals, ken-burns, and chrome transform animations.
donts: Don't introduce Inter, Roboto, Arial, Instrument Serif, or a cream/terracotta palette. Do not switch UI to DM Sans — the build is Manrope via --font-ui.
Don't restore pill nav, pill CTAs, or 16px card radii. The rectangular metallic sheet won.
Don't fill display type with gradients or put a metric/stat strip in the hero.
Don't remount PageAtmosphere / aurora orbs as page wallpaper. Film grain + vignette on cinematic black is the inner-page atmosphere.
Don't treat cyan / burgundy / navy as a brand palette for buttons or type.
Don't use Rockstar, Take-Two, or GTA marks. Atmosphere is allowed; affiliation is not.
Don't invent vanity commerce numbers. Sold counts stay at zero until real orders exist.
